story.title: The Little Rabbit and the Big Hill

scenes.title: A Very Big Hill
scenes.body: In a cozy meadow, a little rabbit looked up at the big, gentle hill. The sun was rising behind it, painting the sky pink and gold. The rabbit's ears drooped—the hill looked so high. But the rabbit wanted to see the sunrise more than anything.
scenes.altText: Scene 1 of a story about courage.

scenes.title: One Small Hop
scenes.body: With a tiny hop, the rabbit began to climb. A friendly butterfly danced beside, saying, 'You are braver than you know.' Step by step, the rabbit kept going, feeling a little braver with every hop. The top seemed closer now.
scenes.altText: Scene 2 of a story about courage.

scenes.title: The Sun Says Hello
scenes.body: At last, the rabbit reached the top and watched the sun bloom like a golden flower. 'I did it!' the rabbit whispered, and the whole meadow seemed to cheer. From that day on, the little rabbit knew that brave starts with just one small step.
scenes.altText: Scene 3 of a story about courage.
